caption: The drawing features a single metallic object centered on a plain off-white or beige background. The object is elongated and symmetrical, composed mainly of a series of connected geometric shapes. It has a brownish color with darker shading suggesting depth and metallic texture. The structure shows several cutouts forming triangular and circular openings along its length. Notably, there are two small circular loops protruding horizontally on each side, one on the upper half and one on the lower half. At both the top and bottom, the object tapers to a rounded end, with the lower part featuring a central ring within a triangular cutout. The artist's signature "McAuley" appears in the bottom right corner, and there are some small orange stains toward the top of the page. The drawing is rendered in realistic detail with fine shading and subtle gradation of color across the surface of the object.
title: Whip Socket
